promotion_rule: A feature may be VERIFIED only when concrete implementation paths and executable tests exist and authoritative repository CI passes on the exact promotion commit. Runtime-dependent integrations retain separate availability truth.

features.evidence_note: Cumulative OneChat tests plus authoritative localhost /api/status and /api/onechat smoke test.
Sandbox validation, proposal/approval flow and rollback regression tests pass.
Authoritative CPU-PyTorch CI trains, saves, loads and backpropagates advanced objectives.
Verified traces, dedupe/splits and explicit web training eligibility/approval are executable tests.
Seed-model output quality and coherent fallback tests pass.

SSRF/private-target boundaries, external-instruction authority, quarantine/security signals, dedupe and explicit training promotion are covered; live public-site reachability remains environment-dependent.
Synthetic importer tests cover supported local corpus formats; remote FineWeb streaming remains dependency/network conditional.
SQLite/WAL storage, definitions/dialogue, lifecycle filtering and fixtures pass.
Lexical relations, style profiling, hybrid sparse+FTS retrieval and retrieval metrics are executable.
Persistence, legal transitions, restart-safe checkpoints and optimistic conflict handling pass.
Execution, verification, recovery and audit-linked envelope lifecycle is regression tested.
Failed-step resume and cancellation behavior pass.
Runtime-connected/configured/unavailable evidence classes are tested independently from declarations.
ALLOW/ASK/ESCALATE behavior and downstream execution checks pass.
Approved invocation validates; mutated arguments/replay binding is rejected.
Scope, risk ceiling, action budget and revocation paths pass.
SQLite WAL, optimistic versioning and legal task-transition enforcement pass.
Untampered envelopes verify and altered payloads are denied.
Manifest validation and Ed25519 signature verification are executable.
Execution is unavailable without sandbox configuration; signed low-risk fixture executes successfully through configured external sandbox boundary.
Registry/runtime presence is separated from connectivity truth.
Local OpenAI-compatible fixture proves status/chat; remote endpoints are blocked by default. Real llama.cpp availability remains runtime-dependent.
Fixture data is visible, hidden by soft deletion, and removed by transactional hard purge.
Real SQLite fixture verifies ranked retrieval plus recall@k and MRR calculation.
Unknown/unavailable/runtime-conditional methods preserve truthful planning states; this does not claim LoRA/QLoRA/DPO training executed.
Deterministic replay snapshots and pass/fail metric regression thresholds are executable.
Authoritative CI scans tracked paths and release manifest reproducibility.
Durable continuation exists, but execution stops when the localhost process is stopped; no background daemon is claimed.
Exact binding is implemented for governed paths tested here; universal coverage across every future adapter is not claimed.
Dependency/status planning exists. Actual adapter training requires compatible external base models, dependencies, compute and a governed training implementation/run.
Small local training is verified; production-scale distributed training is not claimed.
Adapter foundation exists; live behavior requires legitimate external credentials/service availability.
Requires legitimately licensed Oxford data/API credentials; no substitute is presented as Oxford.
Requires real verified fabrication hardware/controller and explicit approval; source presence is not hardware availability.

Legacy JSON migration and transactional registry behavior verified by authoritative repository CI and dedicated behavioral tests.

Dedicated gateway and HTTP integration suites pass on the v0.44 implementation: schema validation, network-destination allowlists, runtime capability evidence, exact approval binding, autonomy budgeting, scoped secret injection/redaction, transactional replay protection, output verification/limits, timeout, cancellation and HTTP Idempotency-Key forwarding. Final main promotion still requires authoritative CI on the exact promotion commit.

Host process enforces timeout, cancellation, output size, minimal environment and declared policy metadata. Filesystem/network/CPU/memory hard isolation still depends on the explicitly configured external sandbox runtime and is not claimed as kernel-enforced by Node itself.

Dedicated SQLite/object-store and live HTTP/OneChat suites pass on v0.45: canonical URI handling, immutable content-addressed objects, revisions, deterministic chunks, quarantine exclusion, retrieval/training separation, source/document/chunk citations, soft deletion, hard purge, reindexing and API composition. PR #4 was merged to main and authoritative main-branch CI passed on merge commit c4d790c3b277297bffee867e4fc55df173acaebb.
The document contract is ready for modality metadata, but OCR/page/bounding-box, audio timestamps, video frame lineage and visual embeddings are not yet implemented.

Verified by the current live API security suite: local governance composition, request/correlation identity, per-route authorization metadata, policy evaluation, exact approval binding and audited actor identity all execute successfully.

Verified by direct identity and live HTTP suites: first-run email/password enrollment, scrypt verification, server-side session records, HttpOnly session cookies, CSRF enforcement, logout/revocation, and authenticated plugin/document/OneChat flows all execute successfully.

Verified by the v0.48 conversation suite: bounded per-chat continuity, connected llama.cpp preference, ForgeLM fallback, truthful no-runtime UNAVAILABLE behavior and OneChat native-conversation integration all pass.
Verified by the v0.48 capability suite across CONNECTED, CONFIGURED, REGISTERED_SOURCE, DEGRADED, UNAVAILABLE, BLOCKED and EXPIRED states plus ranking behavior.

First-run enrollment closes after the first owner is created and is localhost-oriented, but no independent bootstrap-file/device-key ownership proof is currently required before first enrollment. This remains a hardening gap rather than being overstated.

Verified by unit and live system tests: OneChat emits SHA-256 integrity evidence envelopes with claim support states, cited source/chunk excerpts, model route/tool summaries; tampering is detected and explain-answer returns prior structured evidence without private chain-of-thought.

Verified by unit and live system tests: health probing, local/privacy/offline/task/modality constraints, deterministic ranking, rejected-output fallback, llama.cpp selection and authenticated HTTP route simulation all pass.

Verified at source contract plus live shared-chat HTTP behavior: browser sends a stable per-tab chatId and repeated turns with the same chatId produce bounded native conversation continuity and explain-answer linkage.
Turn/evidence records persist in the knowledge store, but the conversation engine does not yet rebuild full conversational model context from persisted turns after process restart.

Verified by v0.49 owner-auth CI: environment bootstrap creates the password-session owner without plaintext credential persistence in the identity record, explicit local credential rotation revokes active sessions, protected HTTP routes reject bearer-only owner requests, and email/password login succeeds through the normal session + CSRF path.

Implementation and deterministic system-facing tests exist on the build branch. VERIFIED is withheld until authoritative CI passes on the exact promotion commit. Live public-web reachability remains runtime/network dependent.
